findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "CODEX & DESIGN PHILOSOPHY // MANIFESTO" above "THE DIGITAL TYPE LAB"; "PRINCIPLE 01 // ORTHOGONAL DISCIPLINE" above "ORDER IS THE PREREQUISITE OF OPTICAL CLA"; "INTERACTIVE SCHEMATIC // 02" above "ANATOMY OF THE LETTERFORM"; "MATHEMATICAL TOOL // 03" above "MODULAR TYPE SCALE CALCULATOR"; "REFERENCE CODEX // 04" above "TYPOGRAPHIC REFERENCE LEXICON"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace — e.g. "SYS_ONLINE // ENGINE v2.4", "|", "COORDINATES: 47.3769° N, 8.5417° E (ZÜRI", "|"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "THE THREE AXIOMS OF TYPE//LAB 11", "ANATOMICAL TELEMETRY"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.lg:col-span-7.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 26 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1440px | div.hidden.lg:flex 1440px | section.relative.border-b 1440px | section.max-w-7xl.mx-auto 1280px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 16 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "LEX_REF #1" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "LEX_REF #2" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "LEX_REF #3" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "LEX_REF #4" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 91 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 107 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 60px (4.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The h1 is 18px ("TYPE//LAB 11").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 2 h1 elements.
findings.fix: One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.7:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.

findings.message: The margins differ: 16px on the left, 28px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
